channel.title: ÆTAS
channel.description: Evidence-based longevity science for women 35+: what the research actually shows about sleep, strength, skin, hormones and supplements.

item.title: Zone 2 cardio for women: what it is and how much
item.description: What zone 2 cardio means, how to find it with the talk test, how much US guidelines call for, and what research says about mitochondria and the hype.

item.title: Pumpkin seed oil for hair: what the study showed
item.description: Does pumpkin seed oil help hair loss? The placebo-controlled trial studied men taking a capsule. What it found, its limits, and the evidence in women.

item.title: Biotin for hair: does it work, and the lab-test warning
item.description: What the research shows about biotin for hair loss in women without a deficiency, how rare deficiency is, and why FDA warns biotin can skew lab tests.

item.title: Thyroid and hair loss: which tests to ask about
item.description: How an underactive or overactive thyroid is linked to hair shedding in women, how common thyroid problems are, and which blood tests check for them.

item.title: Hair thinning in perimenopause: causes and what helps
item.description: Why hair often thins around menopause, the medical causes to rule out, and what the evidence says about minoxidil, spironolactone, PRP and supplements.

item.title: Spironolactone for female pattern hair loss: the evidence
item.description: Spironolactone is used off-label for female pattern hair loss. What reviews of the studies found, side effects, and why it isn’t used in pregnancy.

item.title: Telogen effluvium: sudden hair shedding after stress, illness or surgery
item.description: Why hair can shed in handfuls months after an illness, surgery or childbirth, how long telogen effluvium lasts, and how it differs from pattern hair loss.

item.title: Deep sleep after 35: what changes and what helps
item.description: How deep sleep changes with age and menopause, why night waking rises in midlife, and what the evidence says about CBT-I, melatonin and sleep pills.

item.title: Minoxidil for women: topical vs oral, what the trials show
item.description: Topical minoxidil is the only FDA-approved drug for female pattern hair loss. What trials found, the early shed, and what’s known about oral pills.

item.title: Iron, ferritin and hair loss: what your labs mean
item.description: How low iron is linked to hair shedding in women, what a ferritin test measures, why the cutoffs differ, and why iron pills without testing carry risks.

item.title: Rosemary oil for hair growth: what the one trial really found
item.description: Does rosemary oil regrow hair? The one randomized trial studied men, not women. What it found, what's missing, and what to know about skin reactions.

item.title: NMN and NAD+ supplements: what human trials show
item.description: Do NMN and NR supplements work? What human trials found, including one in postmenopausal women, where they fell short, and where the FDA stands.

item.title: Hair loss in women: the most common causes and how to tell them apart
item.description: Thinning, shedding or bald patches? The main causes of hair loss in women, how each one looks, and what to ask a dermatologist to check.

item.title: Strength training for bone density around menopause: what the trials show
item.description: Can lifting weights protect bone density around menopause? What trials like LIFTMOR found, who was studied, safety, and when to ask about a DEXA scan.

item.title: Urolithin A: what the human trials actually show
item.description: Does urolithin A help muscle and mitochondria? What the human trials found, who was studied, the doses tested and what is still animal-only.

item.title: VO2 max for women: why it matters and how to raise it
item.description: What VO2 max is, how it changes with age in women, what the mortality research shows, and what trials in women found raises it.

item.title: Red light therapy for skin over 40: what the evidence shows
item.description: Do LED masks smooth wrinkles after 40? What the studies behind red light therapy found, what FDA clearance means, and how to use a mask safely.

item.title: Creatine for women over 40: what the research actually shows
item.description: Does creatine help women over 40 with muscle, bone or brain? What the human trials found, the doses they tested, and the honest bottom line.

item.title: Menopause brings abrupt changes in bone, liver and blood fats, huge study finds
item.description: A Nature Medicine study of 300 million lab tests from over a million women found a sudden shift at the final period, with hormones changing 12-15 years earlier.
